name: Software release
description: A made-up release board: groups per component, a checklist every card ticks through, and a set of sections each new card starts with.

cards.title: Show a clear message when the session ends
cards.summary: People lose what they typed when their session ends behind the scenes.

sections.label: Problem
sections.body: The page keeps showing old data after the session ends.

sections.label: Done when
sections.body:
A banner explains what happened
Typed text is still there after signing in again

cards.title: Rate limit the search endpoint
cards.summary: Search is the only endpoint with no limit.

sections.label: Done when
sections.body:
`GET /search` answers `429` past the limit
The limit is in the docs

cards.notes: Waiting on one more read of the retry logic.
